label: early original-phase steps (t=2-3, peak t=3) gated by token identity
explanation: Only fires during the original input phase, and only at steps t=2,3,4. t=3 holds 72% of the mass (active on 40% of t=3 steps), t=2 holds 20%, t=4 holds 8%. It never fires at t=0-1, t>=5, on the delimiter, or anywhere in the copy phase. The position window alone gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.23. Within the window, whether it fires depends on token identity: the current input being v/u/3/j/t/b/k/e/0/c, or the previous input being n/2/t/p/j/1/q/o. It mostly fires on first occurrences of a token (in_first=1 holds 91% of the mass). The strongest activations are v at t=3 after n/p/2 (e.g. n p n [v]). The token dependence looks hash-like and the token sets capture it only partly. Sequence length L has little effect apart from a lower rate at L=3. Positional window t=2-3 with these token sets: dev F1 0.58, mass recall 0.84.
